name: Åland law: Landskapslag (2015:68) om hemvårdsstöd
label: Åland
record_note: 2015:68 from its original text (in force 2016-01-01) with the 7 amending acts replayed to the Ålex consolidation (updated to ÅFS 2026/31); data retrieved 2026-10-28.

scope.when_absent: the amending act prints no transitional or retroactive rule in its commencement provision; the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: no genuine retroactivity (Constitution of Finland 8 §: nullum crimen; legislative practice otherwise), which binds Åland legislation as well
default_reach.meaning: an act applies from the day it takes effect unless its own commencement provision says otherwise (for instance ÅFS 2023/29, which lets the sibling allowance be granted from 1 August 2022); those provisions are copied verbatim into Applies: trailers
default_reach.authority: Suomen perustuslaki 731/1999, 8 §; Självstyrelselag (1991:71) för Åland; each amending act's commencement provision
